studyMode.infoText: Automatically guides you through two short exercise blocks — one without, one with game elements — each followed by a brief questionnaire. Answers are stored anonymized, solely for this thesis, with no names or exercise content. Turn off for free use without this structure.
studyMode.completeMessage: Both exercise blocks and questionnaires are complete. You can keep using the app freely from now on.
